subject: Connector stub patterns & reference impl proposal for LangChain + LlamaIndex
messages:
From: Elliot Shaw <elliot@stackweave.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: maya@stackweave.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal — lightweight connector/stub patterns for LangChain + LlamaIndex (StackWeave x Redwood)

Hi Jasmine,

Really enjoyed our quick intro last week. StackWeave builds tooling for model observability and runtime instrumentation; several of our ISV customers keep asking for a small, well-documented reference integration that shows how to wire up LangChain and LlamaIndex flows with a trace/callback layer that is compatible with Redwood's tracing hooks.

We sketched a short "connector cookbook" that focuses on two goals:
- Minimal, idiomatic adapter code that LangChain/LlamaIndex engineers can drop into a repo (no heavy runtime deps)
- A recommended trace/callback surface that maps to Redwood's Trace API so teams can see request-level latency, token-attribution, and prompt provenance end-to-end

Attachment: lc-lindex-stub-patterns-v1.pdf (2p summary + sample code)

Would Redwood be interested in co-authoring this reference impl and publishing it as a community sample? We can take the initial engineering lift and hand over a maintainable repo; we'd like to discuss compatibility decisions up-front (e.g., whether to prefer a callback shim vs. an explicit middleware wrapper).

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick tech sync (30m) to align on runtime constraints and acceptance criteria
2) Sandbox access for a small Redwood test account so we can validate trace payloads
3) Draft a joint README and permissive license for the sample repo

If this sounds useful, can you point me to the right person on your side and share a day/time this week? I can do Wed/Thu afternoons PT.

Thanks,
Elliot
Principal Product, StackWeave
E: elliot@stackweave.ai
T: +1 415-555-0142

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Elliot Shaw <elliot@stackweave.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal — lightweight connector/stub patterns for LangChain + LlamaIndex (StackWeave x Redwood)

Thanks Elliot — this is squarely in our ISV partner sweet spot. The doc looks concise and pragmatic. We're interested in co-authoring the reference impl and publishing it from the Redwood community samples library.

Quick answers to your questions:
- Preference: start with a callback shim that mirrors LangChain's callback API and an optional explicit middleware wrapper for server-side runtimes. That gives maximum adoption flexibility.
- Acceptance criteria: sample must include (a) end-to-end trace ingestion to Redwood's Trace API with token-level attribution, (b) smoke tests that run against a sandbox endpoint, (c) a short guide for rolling the adapter into a Dedicated/private env.

I'll set up a short tech sync. Vanessa (partnerships lead) and Jonas (runtime/trace) are cc'd to pull in technical and programmatic constraints. Vanessa, Jonas — can you join a 30m call?

Jasmine Liu
Senior Partner Product Manager, Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal — lightweight connector/stub patterns for LangChain + LlamaIndex (StackWeave x Redwood)

Thanks — I'll own the partnership coordination. Technical notes for the sync (Jonas please confirm):
- Sandbox: we will provision a read-only test key scoped to Trace ingestion + a small hosted model route. Provide manual rotation and an allowlist CSV (we'll share format).
- Privacy: the sample should default to no-pii in examples; token samples should be anonymized.
- Runtime constraints: keep example under ~300 lines per adapter, no blocking network calls in the callback surface, and provide a sync + async pattern.
- Tests: lightweight pytest harness + a postman collection for the end-to-end smoke test.

Jonas — can you prepare a 2-slide tech checklist before the call: fields we expect in trace payloads, maximum sample payload sizes, and quick code pointers for attaching KV cache traces?

Vanessa Ortiz
Partnerships Lead, Redwood Inference

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Elliot Shaw <elliot@stackweave.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal — lightweight connector/stub patterns for LangChain + LlamaIndex (StackWeave x Redwood)

Elliot / Maya — great to align. Thanks for the draft PDF; Vanessa will send a sandbox access template (attached: stackweave-sandbox-access.csv) and Jonas will share the 2-slide checklist ahead of the sync.

High-level plan and commitments:
- Week 0 (this week): Tech sync (30m) to lock acceptance criteria and sandbox requirements.
- Week 1: StackWeave provides a PR with the initial adapter code + smoke tests targeting our sandbox.
- Week 2: Redwood does a pass on trace payload shape, provides an example tracing policy, and we co-author README and deployment notes for Dedicated/private.
- Deliverable (end of Week 2): Published community sample repo (MIT) plus a short blog post and a joint sample demo.

Action items:
- StackWeave: confirm Wed 11 Aug 11:00 PT for sync or propose alternative
- Redwood (Vanessa): provision sandbox template and attach access csv (DONE — attached)
- Redwood (Jonas): send 2-slide checklist by Mon 10 Aug

Attachment: stackweave-sandbox-access.csv (format: email,role,access_level,expires)

Looking forward to it.

—
Jasmine Liu
